labels.label: context
labels.reason: The text is only a pointer to the Django 3.2 release notes and describes no change requiring user action.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Support for assigning non-deepcopyable objects to class attributes in TestCase.setUpTestData() will be removed, so existing tests may break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: BaseCommand.requires_system_checks will stop accepting boolean values, so custom management commands using booleans must be updated.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The whitelist argument and domain_whitelist attribute of EmailValidator will be removed, so code using them will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The default_app_config module variable will be removed, so apps relying on it must migrate to AppConfig auto-detection or explicit configuration.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: assertQuerysetEqual() will no longer automatically call repr() on querysets compared to strings, so existing test assertions may start failing.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: django.core.cache.backends.memcached.MemcachedCache will be removed, so deployments using it must switch backends before upgrading.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Support for the pre-3.2 cookie message format in CookieStorage will be removed, so sessions holding old-format messages may be affected during upgrade.
